column6: eval (() => {   const elements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, a'));   const results = [];   elements.forEach(el => {     const text = el.innerText || '';     if (text.includes('404')) {       results.push({         tag: el.tagName,         text: text.trim(),         id: el.id,         href: el.href       });     }   });   return JSON.stringify(results.slice(0, 50)); })()
